description: FateCat OTel collector 与 SLO evidence 契约。该契约只定义 dry-run 与 live evidence 的边界，不保存真实生产指标、trace、日志或告警数据。

requiredChecks.proves: Collector dry-run config, SLO evidence contract, registry links and privacy boundary are machine-verifiable.
Local W3C traceparent propagation, provider/report span logs and SLO policy gate can run without an external backend.
SLO objectives and alert rules are structurally valid.

requiredBeforeProduction.evidence: Collector process or deployment evidence for the current release commit.
Trace backend query URL or exported trace proof with sensitive fields redacted.
Prometheus or equivalent metrics backend scrape/query evidence.
Alert routing or dry/live notification evidence from the configured platform.
Real production traffic window and computed SLO/error-budget evidence.

forbiddenClaimBoundary.allowedClaim: OTel collector/SLO adapter dry-run contract baseline passed locally.

privacyBoundary: Evidence contract must not contain user input, birth place, report body, token, secret, DSN, webhook URL, production logs, metrics snapshot or trace payload.

metadata.risk: 本契约不证明真实 collector、trace backend、alert platform 或 production error budget 已完成。
